Standard populations for age adjustment

Source: R/data.R
std_populations.Rd

Standard population distributions by age group for direct age adjustment with age_adjust() and jp_cluster().

Usage

std_populations

Format

A data frame with columns standard, age_group and population. Standards: "us2000" (2000 United States standard population, Census P25-1130, 19 age groups), "segi1960" (Segi world standard, 18 groups, per 100,000) and "esp2013" (2013 European standard population, 19 groups, per 100,000).

Source

United States Census Bureau, Current Population Reports P25-1130 (2000 standard); Segi M (1960), Cancer mortality for selected sites in 24 countries; Eurostat (2013), Revision of the European Standard Population.

Examples

head(std_populations)
#>   standard age_group population
#> 1   us2000        00    3794901
#> 2   us2000     01-04   15191619
#> 3   us2000     05-09   19919840
#> 4   us2000     10-14   20056779
#> 5   us2000     15-19   19819518
#> 6   us2000     20-24   18257225
tapply(std_populations$population, std_populations$standard, sum)
#>   esp2013  segi1960    us2000 
#>    100000    100000 274633642
